name: How often should I pour water down unused drains to prevent sewer odor?

mainEntity.name: How often should I pour water down unused drains to prevent sewer odor?

acceptedAnswer.text: For drains that are rarely used, such as in guest bathrooms, utility sinks, or floor drains, it's recommended to pour a cup or two of water down them at least once a month. This simple action keeps the P-trap full, creating a water seal that prevents sewer gases from entering your home. If you're away for an extended period, it's a good practice to do this before you leave.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pour water down unused drains monthly to keep P-traps full and prevent sewer gas from entering your home.
